title: High-Dimensional Tensor Regression With Oracle Properties

summary: Missing cross blocks invalidate core low-rank proof; full-ball RSC cannot hold in p>n scalar setting; source proximal routines differ from SCAD.

P1.source: Read p.5 definitions, Lemma14 p.25 decomposition following (23), Eq.(35) p.27, and oracle dependency pp.34-35.
P1.independent_argument: P=Q=e1e1^T gives PWQ=0 and (I-P)W(I-Q)=0 for W=e1e2^T although <W,W>=1. The other two orthogonal matrix blocks are absent. The error A*+epsilon W-A* is allowed even under rank one: [[4,epsilon],[0,0]] has rank one. Moreover its printed low-rank C ratio has numerator zero and nonzero denominator, so that neighborhood does not remove the cross direction.
P1.alternative_and_dependency: An orthogonal pair of subspaces need not be a complementary pair. Noise or curvature assumptions do not supply the missing deterministic projection identity. Replacing F by the tangent space may salvage some arguments but changes its dimension and noise projection.
P1.severity_and_repair: Major retained for the actual core derivation; this is not claimed to be a stochastic counterexample satisfying every Theorem6 event. The exact four-block identity is valid by expanding (P+I-P)W(Q+I-Q); it alone does not reprove the rate.

references.anchors: F and F-perp definitions and projectors

P2.source: Read original p.2 explicit M=N scalar case, p.4 full Frobenius ball and Assumptions2/4, p.5 conditional Theorem5.
P2.independent_argument: For p>n, rank(Z)<=n ensures nonzero h in ker Z for every sample. Choose A=A*, B=A*+th within any radius r>0. Squared loss change and gradient directional product are both zero because Zh=0, contradicting mu t^2||h||^2/2>0. Gaussian population positive definiteness does not change sample rank.
P2.alternative_and_dependency: The report correctly separates a false high-probability full-ball applicability claim from Theorem5 as an implication with an impossible antecedent in this regime. A sparse cone or p<=n can behave differently, neither is the printed full-ball scope.
P2.severity_and_repair: Major retained for the advertised underdetermined scalar application. A new curvature set and error-containment proof are required; no repaired oracle theorem is certified.

P3.source: Read both frozen niAPG.m originals, their prox_operator and local scad functions, and paper SCAD definition p.3. All 50 cited code-file hashes across the group match their initial provenance.
P3.independent_argument: At a=3.7,lambda=1,eta=0.5,z=5, both 4.5 and 5 exceed a lambda, so true penalty is (a+1)/2=2.35. Objective at 4.5 is .125+1.175=1.3 versus 1.175 at 5; shrinkage is not a minimizer. The code plateau (a^2-1)/2=6.345 instead of 2.35 is an independent local discrepancy.
P3.alternative_and_dependency: The earlier sparsity branch is explicitly L1-like and separate solvers exist; the supported nonconvex mismatch is decisive already in the low-rank branch. Historical table execution is unproved. No author code was run.
P3.severity_and_repair: Minor retained; changing the plateau and using the true SCAD prox are necessary local repairs, not validation of the full solver.
